mission_05: The sigmoid function can be implemented as 1 / (1 + exp(-x)), but use the numerically stable version: exp(-max(0,x)) / (1 + exp(-abs(x)))
For negative sampling, generate random (src, dst) pairs and reject those that exist in the positive edge set. Use a set for O(1) lookup
BCE loss = -mean(log(pos_probs) + log(1 - neg_probs)). Clip probabilities to [1e-7, 1-1e-7] to avoid log(0)
